SEPr 13,2022

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago (the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance) be amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and
Multi-Unit District and B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as

shown on Zoning Map Index 12-K, in the area bounded by

South Archer Avenue; South Kostner Avenue; the alley next south of and
parallel to South Archer Avenue; and a line 97.49 feet west of South
Kostner Avenue, as measured along the southerly right-of-way line of
South Archer Avenue and perpendicular thererto,

to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5173 South Archer Avenue
